No. 2029/2– MONDAY JULY 24, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No.
28 OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: 4/1/5/18. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/4/2012 D/297.

I hereby give Notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a Public Purpose: Description of the land/servitude to be acquired:

Two allotments of land called “Heraliyawala watta” in total extent of about 10.1175 Hectares, depicted as lots 01 and 02 in the Preliminary Plan No. Ku 2352 dated 26.04.2017, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys Kurunegala District, situated in the Village called Heraliyawala in Grama Niladhari Division No. 817 of Heraliyawala in Thiragandahaya Korale West in the Divisional Secretary’s Divison Kurunegala in Kurunegala District of the North Western Province and bounded as follows.

Schedule 1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Heraliyawala watta; Description: Home Garden, a mix cultivation of 219 coconut trees of about 5-50 years old, 29 teak trees of about 08-50 years old, 14 permanent buildings, a temporary building, a
foundation, a toilet, 02 water tanks and a cement constructed well are available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 2.7366 Hectares.

2. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Heraliyawala watta; Description: Home Garden, a mix cultivation of 723 coconut trees of about 5-50 years old, 41 teak trees of about 08-50 years old, 09 jack trees of about 10-60 years old, 04 permanent buildings, a temporary building and a foundation are available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 7.3809 Hectares.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Kurunegala Divisional Secretariat on 13 December 2017 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 30th November 2017 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
E. M. M. S. EKANAYAKE, Divisional Secretary, Kurunegala. Divisional Secretariat, Kurunegala, 18th July, 2017.
